name: polydev-perspectives
description: Any model in any agent. Ask AI models from your coding agent and compare the answers. Each answer says what paid for it: your ChatGPT plan, Claude Code or Codex on this machine, your own API key, OpenRouter, or Polydev free requests.
author: Polydev AI

tools.name: get_auth_status
tools.description: Show whether this machine is signed in to Polydev, which sources on this machine are ready (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT plan) and the configured models. When this machine is not signed in, it opens Polydev sign-in in the browser.

user_token.description: Polydev token (starts with pd_). Optional: checks this token if given, otherwise the saved one.

authenticated.description: Whether a valid Polydev token is configured

setup_instructions.step_1: Run the login tool, which opens https://www.polydev.ai in your browser
setup_instructions.step_2: Sign in; the token is saved on this machine
setup_instructions.step_3: Or copy a token from https://www.polydev.ai/dashboard/mcp-tokens and set POLYDEV_USER_TOKEN

output.message: Not connected. Run the login tool to sign in.

examples.description: Check status with a valid token

tools.title: Polydev status

tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in to Polydev in your browser and save the token on this machine, so you do not copy it by hand. In sandboxes without a browser, pass user_token instead.

open_browser.description: Whether to automatically open the browser (default: true)

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for authentication (default: 300 = 5 minutes)

user_token.description: Polydev token (pd_...). Use this where browser login is unavailable (sandboxes, containers). Get one at https://www.polydev.ai/dashboard/mcp-tokens

auth_url.description: URL to open if the browser did not open

tools.title: Sign in to Polydev

tools.name: ask_model
tools.title: Ask models
tools.description: Send a prompt to one or more AI models and return each answer, labelled with what paid for it. With model or models, those models are asked. Without them, your default set is asked: sources on this machine first (your ChatGPT plan for OpenAI models when connected, then Claude Code and Codex under your own login, never the agent that called it), then models through Polydev with your own API keys, OpenRouter or Polydev free requests.

prompt.description: The prompt to send. Include the relevant code, errors and constraints.

model.description: Optional: one model ID to ask, for example a model shown by list_models.

models.description: Optional: several model IDs to ask. Without model or models, your default set is asked.

user_token.description: Polydev token (starts with pd_). Optional when POLYDEV_USER_TOKEN is set or you have run the login tool.

input.prompt: I'm building a new API and choosing between TypeScript and JavaScript. Give the main trade-offs and a recommendation.
My React list re-renders on every keystroke. Here is the component: ... What is causing it and how do I fix it?
Review this microservices design for a payments app. What are the main risks?

tools.name: get_perspectives
tools.title: Ask models (old name)
tools.description: Old name of ask_model. Same inputs and the same behaviour.

prompt.description: The prompt to send. Include the relevant code, errors and constraints.

model.description: Optional: one model ID to ask, for example a model shown by list_models.

models.description: Optional: several model IDs to ask. Without model or models, your default set is asked.

user_token.description: Polydev token (starts with pd_). Optional when POLYDEV_USER_TOKEN is set or you have run the login tool.

tools.name: list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List the models this user can reach right now and what pays for each: the ChatGPT plan, Claude Code and Codex on this machine, and models through Polydev.

tools.name: chatgpt_plan_status
tools.title: ChatGPT plan status
tools.description: Show whether your ChatGPT plan is connected on this machine for OpenAI models, and how to connect or disconnect it.

tools.name: connect_chatgpt_plan
tools.title: Continue with ChatGPT
tools.description: Continue with ChatGPT: start ChatGPT sign-in so that OpenAI models asked through ask_model use your ChatGPT plan. Returns the sign-in link right away (it also tries to open the browser); call chatgpt_plan_status afterwards for the result. The sign-in and its tokens stay on this machine.

timeout_seconds.description: How long the sign-in stays open (default 300)

tools.name: rank_perspectives
tools.description: Rank the answers you got from ask_model, best first, when the user asks for it or agrees. Rankings feed the public leaderboard at https://www.polydev.ai/leaderboard. Pass your own model ID as base_model so the ranking records which model judged.

ranked_models.description: Model IDs ranked best to worst, exactly as shown in the ask_model output

model_scores.description: Optional: a score from 1 to 10 per model ID

feedback_text.description: Optional: why you ranked them this way

base_model.description: Your own model ID (the model making this ranking)

tools.title: Rank answers

tools.name: search_x
tools.description: Search X (Twitter) for recent posts and discussions with xAI's Grok. Needs your own xAI API key, added at https://www.polydev.ai/dashboard/models; it is not part of the free allowance. Returns a summary plus links to the posts.

query.description: What to search for on X. Can be keywords, questions, or topics (e.g. 'MCP servers', 'what are people saying about Claude Code', '@elonmusk AI')

user_token.description: Polydev token (starts with pd_). Optional when POLYDEV_USER_TOKEN is set or you have run the login tool.

model.description: Optional xAI model ID. Leave empty for the default.

examples.description: Search X for trending AI topics

input.query: What are developers saying about MCP servers today?

examples.description: Find posts from a specific user

tools.title: Search X

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image with OpenAI or Google Gemini. Uses your own API key if you added one at https://www.polydev.ai/dashboard/models; otherwise one image takes one request from your free allowance (provider default model, standard settings). Saves a PNG under ~/.polydev/images.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate (e.g. 'a futuristic dashboard with neon lights', 'logo for a developer tools company')

user_token.description: Polydev token (starts with pd_). Optional when POLYDEV_USER_TOKEN is set or you have run the login tool.

size.description: Image size (OpenAI with your own key only). Default: 1024x1024

quality.description: Image quality (OpenAI with your own key only). Default: auto

input.prompt: Minimal logo for a developer tools company, flat, two colours
Architecture diagram of microservices behind an API gateway, clean technical illustration

tools.title: Generate image

setup_instructions.step_1: Add the server to your agent: npx -y polydev-ai@latest
setup_instructions.step_2: Run the login tool (or set POLYDEV_USER_TOKEN from https://www.polydev.ai/dashboard/mcp-tokens)
setup_instructions.step_3: Optional: add your API keys at https://www.polydev.ai/dashboard/models
setup_instructions.step_4: Optional: connect your ChatGPT plan with: npx -y polydev-ai chatgpt login
